qa_pairs.question: Where is the seatbelt warning timer located according to Figure 1?
qa_pairs.answer: The seatbelt warning timer is located below the left-hand side of the dash, above the steering column.

qa_pairs.question: What component is shown in Figure 3 at the top of the steering column?
qa_pairs.answer: Figure 3 shows the air bag gas generator at the top of the steering column with the air bag gas generator removed.

qa_pairs.question: What components are visible in Figure 4 on the top of the steering column with the steering wheel removed?
qa_pairs.answer: Figure 4 shows the horn brush/slip ring, combination switch, ignition switch, and flasher components on top of the steering column with the steering wheel removed.

qa_pairs.question: What part is labeled C260 in Figure 2?
qa_pairs.answer: C260 is a component shown on the underside of the steering column in Figure 2.

qa_pairs.question: Where are the loop contact rings located according to the component views?
qa_pairs.answer: The loop contact rings are located at the top of the steering column, as shown in Figure 3.

qa_pairs.question: What components are shown in Figure 6 on the left-hand side of the evaporator housing?
qa_pairs.answer: Figure 6 shows the evaporator temperature regulator and evaporator temperature sensor on the left-hand side of the evaporator housing.

qa_pairs.question: What is shown inside the steering wheel in Figure 5?
qa_pairs.answer: Figure 5 shows the air bag gas generator inside the steering wheel when it is removed from the car.

qa_pairs.question: What is the page number and section title for this component locations reference?
qa_pairs.answer: This is page 7000-7 from the Component Locations Views section.
